text:
maria: Heads-up — CI started failing intermittently on builder-image jobs after an upstream base image rotated in GCR. Lots of cache misses and long pulls. Anyone else seeing timeouts or registry 429s?
kevin: Yup, saw a spike in build durations yesterday afternoon. Many jobs fell back to full fetch instead of layer cache.
sanjay: Confirmed. The base tag got repointed to a new digest; because we rely on a loose tag in our Dockerfiles the layer fingerprint changes and build cache invalidates.
alex: Logs show repeated pulls from gcr.io/redwood/base:ubuntu-22.04, then a flurry of 403/429 from the registry quotas when the builder pool scaled up.
rachel: Ouch. Also noticed auto-rebuilds from the update bot kicked off a ton of parallel builds which saturated our ephemeral builder nodes and increased egress.
maria: Proposed mitigation: 1) start pinning base image digests in the Dockerfile via an ARG fallback, 2) emit a builder.lock file that records base digests per arch, 3) add a periodic job that checks upstream tags and opens a PR with updated digest + SBOM + CVE report instead of letting the tag rotation trigger mass CI.
kevin: Agree. We should also pre-pull the pinned images onto the builder fleet to avoid cold starts. That might be a small Terraform + Helm change (daemonset pre-pull).
sanjay: Helm change should be opt-in. Add values like `prePull.enabled` and `prePull.images`. Daemonset will be cheap and avoids burst pulls.
maria: We should gate any builder image digest update with SBOM + vuln scan (trivy/ossf-sbom) in the PR so we don't auto-promote a digest with critical CVEs.
alex: We can wire that into our GitOps flow: the periodic "image-checker" job opens PR, GH Action runs SBOM generation + trivy, and only if checks pass we merge. Otherwise it leaves a failing PR for manual review.
rachel: Cost note — frequent digest churn will increase registry egress and builder hours. Add a cooldown and change threshold (e.g., only auto-PR when digest changes and digest age > 7d or severity low).
maria: Example Dockerfile pattern to pin but remain readable:
```
ARG BASE_TAG=ubuntu-22.04
ARG BASE_DIGEST=sha256:PLACEHOLDER
FROM ${BASE_TAG}@${BASE_DIGEST} as base
```
kevin: For Terraform: add a small module that toggles pre-pull daemonset and gives it a list of images to keep warm. We can put it behind a feature flag and roll it to the builder clusters first.
sanjay: I'll prototype a builder.lock generator that resolves tag -> digest for amd64/arm64 and writes JSON + SBOM metadata. It will run as a scheduled job in infra-tools.
alex: I'll draft the GH Actions workflow that runs on PR: build lightweight image (no GPU), generate SBOM (syft), run trivy, and post results as checks.
maria: Action items: kevin -> draft TF/Helm change and perms for daemonset; sanjay -> prototype builder.lock job and push script; alex -> add SBOM + trivy workflow; rachel -> propose cooldown policy and cost guardrails. I'll file a tracking ticket.
infra-bot: Created issue INFRA-472: "builder-image: pinned base digest workflow + pre-pull" and linked this thread.
kevin: I'll open a WIP PR for the helm values by EOD. :thumbsup:
sanjay: Pushed prototype script to infra/tools/builder-locker (WIP), will add tests later.
maria: Thanks all — will sync in 30 to prioritize. :clock3:
